title: THE PISTON · 30/30 PAIRS
why: Thirty minutes, so the clock is tight: three grind-and-ballistic pairs plus one wildcard, 30 seconds each, a sprint leg off every round. Five of the seven bell stations have never been on a card.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 5 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day A · shoulders / spine / wrists

items.name: Jefferson curl ×6
items.detail: slow roll down, slow back up, no weight

blocks.title: THE PISTON · 4 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 4 ROUNDS · 7 stations × 30 s work / 30 s off + 1 sprint leg per round · ~17 min · 35 / 52 lb
blocks.format: One clock. 30 seconds on, 30 seconds off, seven stations in order, then the belt, then straight into the next round. Count reps at every station; the score is total reps across 4 rounds.
blocks.workRest: LEG every round: SPRINT 0.10 mi @ 9.0 flat (about 40 s), walk 20 s, back to station 1. Round 4 at 9.5 if rounds 1 to 3 were clean.

items.name: P1a · Outside-the-legs swing 35 lb · 30 s
items.detail: one-hand swing, bell travels outside the leg, switch hands at 15 s

items.name: P1b · Fireman's squat 35 lb · 30 s
items.detail: bell shouldered, free hand out, squat to depth; switch shoulder each round

items.name: P2a · Palm-up snatch 35 lb · 30 s
items.detail: snatch, finish with the bell flat on the open palm overhead; switch hands at 15 s

items.name: P2b · Kneeling kettlebell curl 35 lb · 30 s
items.detail: tall-kneeling, both hands on the horns, curl to the chin, slow down

items.name: P3a · Skull crusher 52 lb DB · 30 s
items.detail: lying, both hands on the handle, lower to the forehead

items.name: P3b · Offset push-up on the 35 · 30 s
items.detail: one hand on the bell handle, one on the floor; switch at 15 s

items.name: W · Krajewski halo 35 lb · 30 s
items.detail: grab the bell from the floor side, curl it to the chest, lean away and drive it up one side, lower it down the other; alternate

items.name: LEG · SPRINT 0.10 mi @ 9.0 flat · every round

blocks.noteGreen: Green (today): 4 rounds, full 30 s at every station. Stretch: 20 or more reps on every 30 s bell station.
blocks.noteYellow: Yellow: 3 rounds, 20 s on / 40 s off, belt at 8.0.
blocks.text: Outside-the-legs swing: one hand, the bell swings beside the leg instead of between them, hips do the work. Fireman's squat: rest the bell on top of the shoulder as if walking it out of a building. Palm-up snatch: catch the snatch and open the hand so the bell sits flat on the palm at lockout. Krajewski halo: grab the bell from the floor side, curl it to the chest, lean away and drive it up one side, lower it down the other.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · kneeling crossbody halo + windshield wipers + dragon flag negative · straight through

items.name: Kneeling crossbody halo 35 lb ×8/side
items.detail: tall-kneeling, bell crosses from hip to opposite shoulder, around the head

items.name: Windshield wipers ×10
items.detail: on the back, legs up, swing side to side, shoulders pinned

items.name: Dragon flag negative ×6
items.detail: 3-count lower, bench or floor, grip behind the head
